name: My Sweet! Housemate
source:
Faced with the cruel and harsh reality of homelessness, you seek out affordable housing in your area. Luckily, it seems you've found the perfect rental, but something is very off about your landlord...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
面对无家可归的残酷现实，你在你所在地区寻找经济适用房。幸运的是，你似乎找到了完美的出租屋，但你的房东有些不对劲……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3100210/]Steam[/url]]
